ios.desc:
Health care professionals recommend to walk 10,000 steps per day to stay in good shape. You want to take that daily challenge? StepUp is the app you need. Easy to use, it helps you to reach your goal every single day. Stay focus and concentrate on your steps thanks to great features. Taking care of you has never been easier!


…SUPPORTIVE NOTIFICATIONS…
StepUp sends you notifications to help you reach your daily goal. When you’ve reached 10,000 steps, what a pleasure to be congratulated!

…BLOCKING OTHER APPS… 
It’s not easy to concentrate when we are constantly distracted. How many times a day are you using the different apps you have on your phone? StepUp is a good coach: it can block your apps until you hit your daily goal. You want to connect to Instagram? First, walk!

…100% PRIVATE…
Our responsibility is to protect your privacy. StepUp asks to access your Apple Health data. This way, your data stays on your phone. It is not collected or used in any way.

…STUNNING WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN…
Get a nice StepUp widget for your home screen. It will help you follow your daily steps’ number. You can personalize your widget with different colors!

quotes.text:
Even if there is no magic number, all public health experts tend to say, 10000 steps a day is a great milestone to stay in good shape.

As a retro design lover, I've collaborated with Arkadiy Lapshov to create StepUp an iOS app to help people reach 10k steps every day! 
Privacy first, app uses Apple Health data and don't collect any data from you.

App is free, some features such as widgets, daily charts & custom themes are included in StepUp Extended. Please reach out if you're interested in unlocking it for free.

Have a nice walk.
